meta.name: VehicleSecurity
meta.description: Vehicle anti-theft and parked security module. Supports arming, disarming, and querying security state and the current trigger reason. Triggers arise from configured local sensor events. Dismissing an alarm requires authorization; door lock state is still read from Door, and arming does not mean the doors are locked. Recording requests are delegated to Dashcam; an alarm trigger does not mean a recording has been saved.

security_state.description: Current anti-theft state. Alarm indicates that a configured local sensor triggered while the system was armed.

trigger_reason.description: Reason for the current alarm. It is none unless security_state is alarm.

dismissal_authorized.description: Whether the configured local authorization source currently permits dismissal of an active alarm. This module records only the authorization result and does not validate credentials.

get_security_state.description: Return the current security state without changing it. The result does not report or imply any Door lock state.

security_state.description: Current state: disarmed, armed, or alarm.

get_trigger_reason.description: Return the current alarm trigger reason without changing state. The result is none when no alarm is active.

trigger_reason.description: Current trigger reason, or none when no alarm is active.

get_dismissal_authorized.description: Return whether the configured local authorization source currently permits dismissal of an active alarm. This query does not perform authentication or change authorization.

dismissal_authorized.description: Whether alarm dismissal is currently authorized.

arm.description: Arm the anti-theft system while it is disarmed. This action clears any stale trigger reason, does not change Door lock state, and does not request Dashcam recording. A request made from armed or alarm state is rejected without changing state.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: The security system can be armed only while disarmed.

disarm.description: Disarm an armed system that has not triggered and clear the trigger reason. An active alarm must instead be dismissed with dismiss_alarm, which requires authorization. Rejected requests leave state unchanged.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Ordinary disarming is allowed only from armed state; an active alarm requires authorized dismissal.

dismiss_alarm.description: Dismiss an active alarm and return the system to disarmed state, clearing the trigger reason. The action succeeds only while an alarm is active and dismissal_authorized is true. Authorization is supplied by the configured local authorization source; this action does not accept or validate credentials. Failure leaves all state unchanged.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Alarm dismissal requires an active alarm and current authorization from the configured local authorization source.

dependency_changed.description: Mirror the configured local authorization decision into dismissal_authorized. While security_state is armed, an active configured security sensor changes security_state to alarm and records its reported reason. If multiple sensor reasons become active together, select the first by this fixed precedence: door_opened, glass_break, interior_motion, vehicle_tampering. Sensor activity is ignored while disarmed, and an existing alarm preserves its recorded trigger reason until dismissed.

effect_properties.name: security_state
effect_properties.description: Determines whether configured sensor activity can trigger an alarm or whether an existing alarm must be preserved.

effect_properties.name: trigger_reason
effect_properties.description: Preserves the reason already recorded for an active alarm.

effect_properties.name: dismissal_authorized
effect_properties.description: Stores the current authorization result supplied by the configured local authorization source.
